asset.name: Cardano

score_rationales.institutional: Institutional rails exist—Coinbase Custody Trust Company (NYDFS chartered qualified custodian) and Coinbase Prime support ADA custody and staking, and ADA is a named component of Grayscale’s CoinDesk Crypto 5 ETF (GDLC) at about 0.67% of the portfolio per SEC-related listing disclosures (Nov 2025). The NYSE Arca rule change to list Grayscale Cardano Trust ETF shares was withdrawn in September 2025, so U.S. spot ETF access remains behind Bitcoin and Ethereum despite these fund and custody hooks.
score_rationales.regulatory: In March 2026 the SEC and CFTC issued a joint interpretation that explicitly cites Cardano (ADA) among illustrative “digital commodities” under the Commodity Exchange Act, aligning U.S. enforcement posture with a commodity framing rather than a blanket security label. In the EU, the Cardano Foundation joined the MiCA Crypto Alliance (Oct 2025) and supports MiCA-ready disclosures (including an industry ADA white paper and Cardano-token templates), giving EU venues a compliance path—while the U.S. guidance remains an interim agency position open to comment, not a final rule.
score_rationales.supply: ADA has a protocol-enforced 45 billion hard cap with no uncapped minting; circulating supply is roughly 36.8–36.9 billion ADA (~82% of max per Glassnode/CoinGecko-class figures), so most coins are already distributed while remaining issuance comes from the decaying staking reserve and treasury rather than opaque VC cliffs. On-chain staking participation is very high (commonly reported ~60–75% of supply delegated across thousands of pools), which materially reduces liquid float versus non-staked supply even without lockups. Remaining scheduled emissions still dilute holders until reserves exhaust, and short-term exchange-reserve direction cannot be asserted from the data given—so the score is strong but not maximal.
score_rationales.wyckoff: Wyckoff phase carried from last snapshot until the next daily indicators refresh.
score_rationales.adoption_activity: DefiLlama chain stats show roughly $136M DeFi TVL (often mid‑20s among chains), ~$49M stablecoin market cap, ~16k active addresses and ~25k transactions in 24h—real DeFi and daily usage, but TVL and on-chain activity remain far below top L1 leaders.
